name: Stamp Master
summary: Welcome to Stamp Master, the ultimate game of speed, precision, and skill! In this immersive game, you take on the role of a stamp master tasked with stamping, sealing, and approving documents at lightning speed. With each level, the challenges grow, testing your accuracy and timing as new patterns and unique stamping requirements are introduced. Will you keep up as the pressure rises? Perfect each stamp, earn points, and unlock a collection of special stamps that bring new features and designs. But beware—
